crossRefs.note: Strap your sword on your thigh, mighty one: your splendor and your majesty.
The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be…
For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called…
In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing within the earth;
Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing, marching…
Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
And behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to…
I saw the heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness…

translations.web: Who is the King of glory? Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.
translations.bsb: Who is this King of Glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
translations.kjv: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
translations.asv: Who is the King of glory? Jehovah strong and mighty, Jehovah mighty in battle.
